verdict.rationale: GitCafe is a Git forge, so rendering Markdown in READMEs, issues and comments is a fair question, but nothing in the evidence documents Markdown rendering or code syntax highlighting. The 'read as Markdown' feature (gitcafe-docs-25) is the reverse direction: it exports pages as raw Markdown text for scripts and agents. The llms.txt README excerpt (gitcafe-docs-45) is also unrelated to rendering. Neither earns credit for this story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can write READMEs, issues, and comments in Markdown that render with formatted prose and highlighted code
